title: Create functions for the contacts between primitive shapes
author: Claude-JG
description: The design of the primitive contacts (docs/dev/design/contactPrimitives.md) proposes mbs.Create functions, which add the markers, the data node of the right size and the contact item for two bodies; a user now adds the data node with its initial coordinates by hand. Decided: Create functions for the sphere, cylinder, cone, triangle and convex contacts, with the shapes in the frames of the bodies, as the other Create functions.
releaseNotes: mbs.CreateSphereCylinderContact, CreateCylinderCylinderContact, CreateCylinderTriangleContact, CreateConeConeContact, CreateConeTriangleContact and CreateConvexConvexContact add a contact between primitive shapes with its markers and a data node of the right size; cylinders and cones are placed by a local position and a local axis on their body.
